recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-14813 unless a future work-group decision changes Account lifecycle/status modeling; historical version-mapping entries and generated-looking diagrams should not be edited for this issue.
issue_request: FHIR-14813 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Patient Administration change request for STU3 Account. It requested removal of Account.active, renaming Account.period to Account.servicePeriod, clarifying the definition to 'The date range of services associated with this account', and adding the comment that transactions may be posted outside the service period when the service occurred within it.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by e88e991a574185bed8cad539e6ab012cab0cca51, which removed Account.active from the historical Account spreadsheet source, renamed Account.period to Account.servicePeriod, updated the requested definition/comment, and changed Account examples from period/active to servicePeriod. Later source refactoring regenerated Account as StructureDefinition XML while preserving that application.
additional_context: Account remains an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-14811 separately made Account.status mandatory and added status codes, and FHIR-14963 later added Account.billingStatus for billing/lifecycle processing; FHIR-14963 already has a reconcile audit commit on the combined branch. These related decisions explain current Account.status/billingStatus content and do not reintroduce the removed Account.active period element.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The authoritative Account StructureDefinition has Account.servicePeriod with the approved definition/comment, examples use servicePeriod, and searches found no current Account.active element; the remaining Account.active text is only an R2 rename-map entry, not current Account content.
